Candid Frames — Wedding Photography & Films, Bengaluru

Candid Frames is one of Bengaluru's better-known mid-range wedding photography
teams, covering South Indian ceremonies, Christian weddings, and multi-day North
Indian functions across the city's banquet and resort circuit. They are known
for a documentary-style approach and quick turnaround on highlight videos.

Their standard package (two photographers, one cinematographer, two events) is
₹1,25,000, with albums and additional events priced separately. They offer a
free consultation and a sample album review before booking.

Contact: +91 96860 45512 · contact@candidframes.example
Location: Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka
Rating: 4.5 / 5 (203 reviews)

What couples say:
"Beautiful candid shots, very natural and unposed."
"The highlight film made us cry — captured the whole day's emotion."
"Friendly team, easy to coordinate with."

Candid Frames maintains a large freelance crew during peak season, which lets
them take on several weddings on the same weekend. Their editing house handles
color grading in-house, and most couples receive their teaser within a week.

A recurring concern in more recent reviews deserves attention: for at least
three weddings in 2023, couples reported the final album and full-length film
were delivered four to five months late — well beyond the promised 6–8 weeks —
and one couple stated that raw footage from their reception was partially lost
due to a "drive failure" with no backup, so a portion of the evening was never
recovered. The studio has acknowledged the delays and says it has since added a
second backup workflow.

Overall, Candid Frames remains a solid choice for couples who value candid
storytelling at a reasonable price, provided delivery timelines and backup
practices are confirmed in the contract.
